recovery.meaning: Clean pinned MoErgo firmware with the exact Ralf Custom Swiss v8 keymap; it preserves the bootloader and settings partition.

changes: Use a BLE notification for right-half acknowledgements and require its encrypted-read permission.
Make interaction entry, exit, and cell events atomic with lease expiry.
Bound split submission and delivery to 3500 ms inside a 4000 ms relative-lease reserve.
Express transparent clear lifetime as the reserve plus an explicit one-second lease, avoiding unsigned underflow.
Keep transparent clear scenes eligible after queue delay while bounding each transfer attempt.
Clear a stale local overlay when electrical limits reject a new scene.
Hold printed Up for primary actions or printed Down for secondary actions; release returns immediately to the preserved Swiss v8 typing layout.
Cache two 80-cell availability masks with each atomic scene so both halves can reveal available actions without host RGB streaming.
Render held-modifier and action-key pressed feedback locally; the first modifier wins and a 30-second fail-safe closes a lost hold.

knownUncertainty.rightAcknowledgement: Alpha6 repeatedly aborted the twelve-fragment transfer before the right half rendered. Alpha7's corrected bounded timing and acknowledgement permission compile and reproduce, but still require post-flash hardware proof.
knownUncertainty.splitTiming: The 3500 ms transfer bound is inside a 4000 ms lease reserve; successful delivery therefore retains a 500 ms expiry margin. Actual timing still requires hardware measurement.
knownUncertainty.interactionFeedback: Printed Up/Down positions and their right-side LED channels are derived from the checked-in topology and compiled DTS; physical confirmation still requires the grouped flash gate.
knownUncertainty.rightLedOrder: Physical cell 40 rendered on F6 during alpha1 testing; complete right-side order still requires host-side calibration.
knownUncertainty.transport: Runtime control is intentionally USB-only in protocol v3; BLE typing remains stock.
